content_units: Kyoto Dinner Fit at a Glance
Best overall pick:   C) Tofu Hana

It best matches the full group needs: vegetarian-friendly, shellfish-safe by menu profile,   quiet enough for conversation  , and comfortably within the   JPY 18,000   food budget for 6 people. A 19:00 start also suits a more relaxed sit-down dinner better than a fast-turnover spot.
Ranked Dinner Options
Rank   Option   Estimated Total for 6   Vegetarian Fit   Shellfish-Avoidance Fit   Conversation Fit   Overall Verdict
1     Tofu Hana       JPY 14,400     Excellent   Strong   Excellent   Best balance of all constraints
2     Sora Udon       JPY 9,600     Good   Good   Fair   Budget winner, but less ideal for a relaxed group dinner
3     Noodle Alley       JPY 6,600     Weak   Fair   Poor   Cheap, but misses key comfort and dietary priorities
1) Tofu Hana
-   Why it ranks first:   It is the only option that clearly satisfies the two most important non-price constraints at the same time:   vegetarian support   and a   quiet setting  .
-   Budget check:   2,400 × 6 =   JPY 14,400  , leaving   JPY 3,600   under budget before drinks.
-   Group fit:   Traditional, quieter dining is much better for a 6-person dinner around 19:00 when conversation matters.
-   Dietary fit:   “Many vegetarian dishes” makes planning easy for the vegetarian guest, and nothing suggests a shellfish-heavy menu.
2) Sora Udon
-   Why it ranks second:   Very affordable and clearly vegetarian-friendly.
-   Budget check:   1,600 × 6 =   JPY 9,600  , well under budget.
-   Trade-off:   The   casual, quick-turnover   setup makes it less suitable for a quieter, lingering dinner conversation at 19:00.
-   Best if:   Your group prioritizes value and simplicity over ambiance.
3) Noodle Alley
-   Why it ranks third:   It fits the budget easily, but it clashes with the experience you want.
-   Budget check:   1,100 × 6 =   JPY 6,600  .
-   Main drawbacks:     Cramped, noisy  , and has   limited vegetarian choices  .
-   Why it still places above Ember Grill:   At least it does not explicitly conflict with the shellfish restriction the way Ember Grill does.
Why Ember Grill Misses the Cut
-   Shellfish-heavy menu   is a poor fit for one guest avoiding shellfish.
-   Lively noise level   conflicts with the goal of easy conversation.
- Cost is   JPY 22,800   for 6, which is   over the JPY 18,000 budget   before drinks.
Booking Context for This Pick

Using the provided candidate details only,   Tofu Hana   is the strongest recommendation because it meets the most constraints with the fewest compromises. If Tofu Hana is unavailable,   Sora Udon   is the best fallback.
